units.source_text: 在和服店林立的西阵一带也是这样，虽挤满了看上去挺寒碜的小铺子，路面却比较干净。

en.t: It was the same in the Nishijin area, where kimono shops stood side by side: although it was crowded with shabby-looking little stores, the streets were fairly clean.

units.source_text: 即使有小格子，上面也不积灰尘。

en.t: Even where there were small lattice windows, no dust had gathered on them.

units.source_text: 植物园等地也是如此，没有乱扔的纸屑。

en.t: It was the same in places like the botanical garden, with no scraps of paper thrown about.
